sentences.text: Xixiposaurus was a sauropodomorph dinosaur, a saurischian prosauropod, that lived in ancient China.
The genus was first named by Sekiya Toru in 2010, with the type species designated as X. suni to honor Professor Sun Ge of Jilin University.
Xixiposaurus is placed as the sister taxon to Mussaurus within the family Plateosauridae, which also included Riojasaurus, Coloradisaurus, and "Gyposaurus" sinensis.
This animal lived approximately 203 to 183 million years ago between the Hettangian and Pliensbachian stages in what is now Asia.
The fossil record for Xixiposaurus spans from the Hettangian to the Sinemurian, between 201.4 and 192.9 million years ago.
A hypothesis placing Xixiposaurus as a derived member of a monophyletic Prosauropoda proposed by Sekiya in 2010 is currently unaccepted.
